name: work-monitor
description: Pane showing every agent's activity, progress, model/effort, tokens, equivalent cost, what is left to do, and remaining rate-limit quota.

compactToolRows.title: Compact tool rows in the transcript
compactToolRows.description: Show ordinary tool calls as a single dim line with just the tool name (no command text). Errors, interruptions and permission prompts are never collapsed.

planFile.title: Plan checklist file
planFile.description: Markdown checklist (- [ ] / - [x]) read from the working directory to show what is left to do.

prices.title: Price table (USD per million tokens)
prices.description: JSON: {"opus":{"in":5,"out":25},"sonnet":{"in":3,"out":15}, ...}. Cache read is 0.1x input and cache write 1.25x unless given as cr/cw. Defaults are ASSUMPTIONS; edit them to your plan's real rates.
